text: Salumificio Fratelli Beretta presents itself as a 100% family brand: an inheritance passed down from father to son, built by nine generations since 1812.
short: Fratelli Beretta, a family business now in its ninth generation.

source.name: Fratelli Beretta, 'Gruppo e Storia' (company website, via Wayback Machine)
source.quote: tramite l’impegno diretto di una Family Brand al 100%
source.note: The live site serves a bot-check to scripts, so the archived page (snapshot 8 May 2026) was used. Translation: 'through the direct commitment of a 100% Family Brand.' The same page: 'Passione per la qualità dal 1812', 'L'impegno di nove generazioni' and 'Un'eredità tramandata di padre in figlio'.

additionalSources.name: Eventinews24, 'Il Gruppo Fratelli Beretta'
additionalSources.quote: Guidato dall’ottava generazione della famiglia del fondatore Carlo Antonio Beretta, il Gruppo opera sul mercato con tre marchi: Beretta, Wuber e Viva la mamma.
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Led by the eighth generation of the family of founder Carlo Antonio Beretta, the Group operates on the market with three brands: Beretta, Wuber and Viva la mamma.'
